statement.text: If $X$ is a class of groups, let $H(X)$ denote the class of homomorphic images of groups in $X$, let $S(X)$ denote the class of groups isomorphic to subgroups of groups in $X$, let $P(X)$ denote the class of groups isomorphic to (unrestricted) direct products of families of groups in $X$, and let $P_f(X)$ denote the class of groups isomorphic to direct products of finite families of groups in $X$. By Birkhoff's theorem, $H(S(P(X)))$ is the variety of groups generated by $X$. If $M$ is a class of metabelian groups, must $H(S(P_f(M)))\subseteq S(H(P(S(M))))$?
